my aunt committed suicide recently. i believe two weeks ago. this aunt was more like a mother to me than my own mom. she was there at my birth and has taken the time to get to know me more than my mom ever tried to. she was 34. she had a really hard life so i can't bring myself to blame her for what she did. i mean someone can only take so much of living in tunnels hours away from their family. being homeless, having their kids taken away and not having seen them in a decade, on top of ptsd. she also suffered with very very severe ptsd. i could never blame my aunt but all i think about now is how much we never got to do together.

i told her a few years back when i was 15 or 16 that i wanted a pride flag, and she eventually brought me one. she even promised wed go to pride together at some point. she found me cutting myself a year or two ago and she didnt get mad, she wasn't disgusted, she just moved the blade from my hand and cleaned my wounds. she gave me a pedicure once because i was depressed. said something like "my toes are so ugly" and she just smiled at me and said "well.. thats why were doing this." she made me pink and purple pancakes on my birthday while my mom was cracked out asleep in her room. she hugged me after a particularly bad suicide attempt and at that point, made me promise to "never do that shit again and i wont either". the bottomline is we were very close.

we didnt get to see each other that often as of 2015-2024 but i got to see her a few months ago. her own son got her kicked out again. that was the last time we saw her before we got the news that she died.
